content.passage: This year, a group of adult learners has completed several projects. They have improved their communication skills and learned to work with different people. Although some tasks were challenging, the group found practical solutions. One student said that if she had more time, she would volunteer at a local centre. By the end of the course, everyone will have prepared a short presentation about their progress and future goals.

items.prompt: Describe a skill you have improved this year.
items.modelAnswer: During this course, I have become more confident using English in everyday situations. I can describe experiences, explain opinions and ask for information more politely. I have also learned how to talk about plans, solve problems and work with other people. Some grammar points were difficult at first, but regular practice helped me improve. In the future, I would like to use English more often at work and when travelling.

content.audioTranscript: A: How have you found the course? B: Very useful. I've developed new skills and gained more confidence. A: What has helped you most? B: The practical experience and speaking tasks. A: Have you shared your opinions in class? B: Yes, and we've solved several problems together. A: What are your plans for the future? B: I want to achieve my goals and continue making progress.
